answer: New identities start at zero weight, sitting on a flat mesa of no influence, while honest agents climb the ridge of earned trust. Sybil resistance here uses a staked reputation ledger: each agent must lock a bond and accumulate verified peer attestations before its votes count. Forging thousands of fakes costs real capital per identity and yields nothing until attestations accrue, making each fake a costly pearl that buys no leverage. Attackers must outspend the entire honest stake to shift outcomes. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
